The Approximate Number Generation chart has three slices: Comparative Relationships (light blue, 36.26%), Approximate Quantities (yellow, 45.03%), and Absolute Absence (coral, 18.71%). The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart contains two slices, Disjunctive (light blue, 49.51%) and Conjunctive (pink, 50.49%). Each chart includes percentage labels displayed inside the slices. The slices in each chart do not appear to be ordered in any particular way.
